fields.name: code
fields.short: HTTP code representing the outcome of the status request.

fields.name: cumulative
fields.short: If true, sum across bands so that a given band value is the sum of all preceding values plus the band value.

fields.name: data_source
fields.short: A string value representing the cohort type

fields.name: dimensions
fields.short: An array representing dimension(s) to group by.

fields.name: enable_install_recalculation
fields.short: If true, then Branch will de-dupe unattributed installs caused by duplicate events from non-opt-in users coming from paid ads.

fields.name: end_date
fields.short: The end of the interval time range represented as an ISO-8601 complete date.

fields.name: error_message
fields.short: Error message if the query failed

fields.name: filter
fields.short: "Keys are same as dimensions.

fields.name: granularity
fields.short: The time granularity that each band value will represent.

fields.name: granularity_band_count
fields.short: Number of time units since the cohort event to return to the user.

fields.name: job_id
fields.short: Unique identifier used to retrieve job status and data.

fields.name: measures
fields.short: The cohort measures to return.

fields.name: ordered
fields.short: Order of response based on ordered_by value.

fields.name: ordered_by
fields.short: The dimension used for sorting

fields.name: per_user
fields.short: If true, divide each band value by the user count.

fields.name: response_url
fields.short: S3 url for downloading the response data.

fields.name: start_date
fields.short: The start of the interval time range represented as an ISO-8601 complete date.

fields.name: status
fields.short: Status of the query.

fields.name: status_url
fields.short: More information about the subscription's status.

fields.name: unique
fields.short: Whether or not to return unique values.
